Manifest pack audit

For every set in the aggregator pack, fetches candidate npm packages and scores them against the committed icons. Nothing is accepted on a name: a candidate is believed only when the bytes it ships match the bytes already committed. A survey, not a gate: unresolved sets are work for a person. It reads the pack tree and writes only temporary downloads.

The aggregator pack's config is not loaded

The audit reads the aggregator pack, whose config is private. Start the server with --private-config-dir pointing at that pack's .dev/icon-sets-sync directory.
